title: wm shortcuts.toml
description: The binds that the Shortcuts window of wm manages. init.lua loads them with wm.shortcuts(). Keep it in step with Sources/Scripting/Shortcuts.swift.

shortcut.description: One bind, the same as one wm.bind (or wm.remap) call.

keys.description: A chord such as "alt-h" or "cmd+ctrl-2", or a sequence of chords joined by >, such as "ctrl-p>h". Modifiers: alt, cmd, ctrl, shift, hyper.

action.description: A wm command line, the same text as `wm <command>` in a shell. An empty string swallows the key. Use either action or remap.

remap.description: Types this key when `keys` is pressed, such as "left" or "cmd-right", or a media key: volume_up, volume_down, mute, play, next, previous, brightness_up, brightness_down. Use either action or remap.

mode.description: The binding mode of the shortcut. Default "main".

description.description: Text for `wm list binds` and the key panel.

repeating.description: false: run once per press. true: run for each repeat of the held key (a single chord only).

release.description: Run when the key comes up. A single chord only.

long_press.description: Run when the key is held: true waits for binds.long_press_timeout, a number is the seconds to wait (0.1 to 3). A single chord only.

universal.description: The shortcut works in every mode.

hidden.description: Leave the key out of the key panel.
